title: So slow and buggy!
body: I wish the app wasnt so slow and buggy. It’s not syncing between devices. Love how simple it is to use but hate how annoying it is. Right now my full list of habits are not showing but they are visible in the progress bar. So frustrating.

title: Love the new streak icon
body: The new streak icon on the right is really motivating. The design is pretty good too. Good job!
author: Kokismonster

title: Important!: Count needed 🆘
body:
The app has a lot awesome features, I like it. As a HabitBull user for years this app can replace it for me without any inconveniences. I would also strongly suggest that it has a count feature same as timer. So that instead of achieving certain amount of time, we can chose to achieve certain count. Example: eat 5 meals per day, then we can count after each meal. Drink 6 glasses of water per day, we can do the same. So throughout the day I can see how many glasses of water I have already taken. 

As a paid user for upgrades and a iOS developer myself , I would really appreciate if you guys forward this requirement. All the best 💪🏻💪🏻
author: tdsolo
